tagline: Fast desk talking-head reels: every word pops on your chest in two sizes, and a giant number or word stands behind your head.
needs: just you at a desk (props and your own B-roll make it better, both optional)
readiness_note: Best with one or two props in the hook and a few of your own B-roll clips; every one has a built-in fallback.

captions: Hook: '3 SKILLS' slams in behind the head while two-tier captions build on the chest
Signature: a neon ₹1,20,000 odometer rolls behind the head, captions 'rupees / per month'
Theme TH-yellow: a year ruler and '5 YEARS' counting up behind the head
